"use client"
// Probe for the upload-surface arm of tests/unit/all-clear-honesty.test.ts.
// RED: says the analysis is running whenever the commit SUCCEEDED — the
// pre-Sept-2026 shape, where the token gate ran later inside after() and
// refused on the free agent tier every time. `success` is not `queued`.

import { commitScannedPolicy } from "@/app/(protected)/agent/actions"

export function ProbeSuccessView({ up, result }: { up: any; result: { success: boolean } }) {
    return (
        <div>
            {result.success && (
                <p role="status">{up.analysisStarted}</p>
            )}
            <p>{"Η ανάλυση τρέχει στο παρασκήνιο"}</p>
        </div>
    )
}

export async function probeCommit(fd: FormData) {
    return commitScannedPolicy({ mode: "attach", customerId: "c" }, {} as any, false, fd)
}
